protocol.method: Sample-based finite-horizon fitted afterstate Q iteration with hierarchical shrinkage
protocol.trainingDesign: Each replicate draws 12,000 market seeds with replacement from its own disjoint 12,000-seed block, crossed with every training pattern. Repeated draws count as training episodes.
protocol.selection: One fixed estimator and its matched history ablation. Release seed 13 regardless of validation or test performance.
protocol.primary: Lower paired 95% interval endpoint > 0 vs posted stochastic planner, equal mix of fresh test patterns
protocol.reversalRepair: Lower paired 95% interval endpoint > 0 vs released Drift RL on fresh reversal stratum
protocol.retention: On each of the fresh interrupted-drop stratum and old interrupted-drop generator guard, lower endpoint > 0 vs posted planner and > -1 credit vs Drift RL
protocol.joint: All four prespecified checks must pass
protocol.diagnostics: Direct reversal comparison with both planners, matched history ablation, original Drift reversal on the guard seeds, and history-sensitive decisions
protocol.uncertainty: Two-sided paired percentile intervals clustered by scenario seed, conditional on patterns and release checkpoint; stratum and diagnostic intervals are unadjusted
